customer: Selling my hatchback to you soon, just moved here. When can I drop the insurance on it?
agent: Per our article "When to cancel your insurance," keep the car insured until the sale is complete and the car is in our hands, including on the day of a home pickup. Cancel your policy, or remove the car from it, only after you sign the paperwork. You can ask your insurer about a refund for the unused part of your premium. Before handing it over, please also remove toll tags and personal data like garage codes and paired phones.
